bifrost: springboard/src/shell/dnd.rs, springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs, springboard/ui/src/drag_session.rs, springboard/sdk/src/item_provider.rs, springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs, springboard/ui/src/spring_load.rs, springboard/sdk/src/spring_loaded.rs, springboard/ui/src/paste_control.rs, springboard/sdk/src/paste_control.rs, springboard/ui/src/text_drag.rs
summary: Typed drag and drop between app windows works through the shell with operation negotiation, file grants and a preview image, and item providers carry typed data. Spring-loaded interactions (a hover timer that activates a target once), a paste control that reads the pasteboard on a tap, and text drag and drop customization exist as models with unit tests, built on parity/team-p-drag-drop and not yet verified on the tablet. Attaching interactions to views with touch lift, drop proposals with progress, and Split View pane targets are still missing.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: an app sends DragBegin with items, allowed operations and a preview; the shell owns the pointer afterwards. No view-attached interaction and no lift-on-long-press for touch
register types, receive Entered, Updated, Exited and Perform, answer with copy, link or move; no proposal with progress indicator style and no per-item acceptance

features.apple: dragging between apps in Split View
features.note: the shell hit-tests app windows in the desktop; whether Split View and Slide Over panes of handheld mode act as separate destinations is not covered by code or tests

features.apple: NSItemProvider, NSItemProviderReading, NSItemProviderWriting, drag item as promise
features.note: typed representations, registered up front or lazily; file representations travel as read-only grants
a small preview image is sent at the start; no preview parameters, no lift or drop animation hooks, no multi-item stack

built on parity/team-p-drag-drop; not yet verified on the tablet. The hover timer and activation handler exist; the app must feed drag updates and a tick, because the shell does not yet forward ticks or spring-load events
typed pasteboard items by UTType; no declared accepted types on a responder
built on parity/team-p-drag-drop; not yet verified on the tablet. The tap is the consent, so the read shows no prompt; the button is not yet drawn by a shell widget

features.apple: text view drag and drop customization
features.note: built on parity/team-p-drag-drop; not yet verified on the tablet. Drag payload, drop proposal and drop application are pure functions; springboard/ui/src/textview.rs does not call them yet
named pasteboards with typed items, mapped to Wayland MIME types by the shell

gaps: Attach drag and drop interactions to views, with touch lift on long press
Shell forwarding of spring-load ticks and events to apps, and the hover effect drawn by the shell
Wire the text view to the text drag policy (drag start, proposal and drop)
Paste control drawn as a shell widget with the system look
Drop proposals with progress style and per-item acceptance
Drag preview parameters and animation hooks
Check Split View and Slide Over panes as drop targets
